_what: barrage — built from the v26 reference (a Marvel character tour). First style on the shelf that is not the house system. Read studio/reference/barrage_v26.md for the frame-by-frame it came from.

engine.grade: barrage, attached to the plan and applied by compose.grade

rules.whip: every 4th cut (idx % 4 == 2), never on a flash
rules.breakdown_audio: only when the track has a genuinely quieter section inside 50-85%; never faked

grade.note: bright and flat so a three-frame flash reads as white, not grey. Target: luma ~85, saturation ~0.33.

tests_run.verdict: passes on footage it was not built on — the style is the rules, not the shots

known_gaps: No endcard and no credit card yet. The reference has a credit card at 2.83s and a logo for its last 2.4s; both are institution-specific and neither is built.

The instrument reads our own renders at ~1.5x the plan's cut count, because the look layer's entry settle registers as a cut. The reference file measures 52 and its plan is 52. Compare plan-to-plan, or ratios.
Whips are two-frame joins, not the reference's 3.3s blur runs.
